newsitem.title: UK: Oppenheimer hires Dean Witter sales/trading team.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer hires Dean Witter sales/trading team.

text.p: Oppenheimer International Ltd, the London-based subsidiary of U.S. securities and investment bank Oppenheimer & Co. said on Tuesday that it had hired a seven-strong U.S. equity sales trading and sales team from Dean Witter.
Nick Robinson, former senior salesman at Dean Witter, and Jonathan Denham have become Senior Vice Presidents, U.S. equity sales at Oppenheimer, effective immediately, the company said in a statement.

In addition, Michael Shorthouse, former head of sales and trading for Dean Witter in Britain, has become head of sales and trading at Oppenheimer. The rest of the team will support the existing U.S. sales team, the company said.
